name: Piquenique & Ukuleles
description: Join the Portukulele community for a relaxed Sunday afternoon picnic filled with the charming sounds of ukuleles. All are welcome to listen or play along.
longDescription:
Piquenique & Ukuleles is a community gathering organised by Portukulele, a local group dedicated to the ukulele. This event provides an opportunity for enthusiasts and curious newcomers alike to share their passion for the instrument in a casual outdoor setting. It serves as a regular meeting point for the community, fostering musical exchange and enjoyment.

Attendees can anticipate a relaxed Sunday afternoon atmosphere at Quinta do Covelo, a green space within Porto. The event is characterised by the gentle melodies of ukuleles, with participants encouraged to bring their own instruments to play along or simply enjoy listening to the music. The gathering is open to all ages and skill levels, creating an inclusive environment for both musicians and those who appreciate live, acoustic music.

This event is free to attend, with no prior registration required. Quinta do Covelo is accessible via public transport; the venue is a short walk from the Combatentes metro station. The outdoor setting makes it suitable for families.
